events.title: 베이징에서 혁명원로의 아들로 태어나다
events.title_en: Born in Beijing to a revolutionary veteran
events.description: 베이징에서 시중쉰의 아들로 태어났다. 아버지는 중국공산당 건국 원로로 부총리를 지낸 인물이다.
events.description_en: He was born in Beijing, the son of Xi Zhongxun, a veteran of the Communist revolution who later served as a vice premier.

events.title: 산시성 량자허로 하방되다
events.title_en: He was sent down to Liangjiahe in Shaanxi
events.description: 문화대혁명 시기 아버지가 실각하자 열다섯 나이로 산시성 량자허 마을로 보내졌다. 이후 7년 동안 토굴집에 살며 농사와 막노동을 했다.
events.description_en: When his father fell from power during the Cultural Revolution, he was sent at fifteen to the village of Liangjiahe in Shaanxi Province. For the next seven years he lived in a cave dwelling and worked the fields.

events.title: 중국공산당에 입당하다
events.title_en: He joined the Communist Party of China
events.description: 여러 번의 신청 끝에 중국공산당에 입당했다. 량자허 생산대대의 당지부 서기도 함께 맡았다.
events.description_en: After several rejected applications he was admitted to the Communist Party of China. He also became party branch secretary of the Liangjiahe production brigade.

events.title: 칭화대에서 화학공학을 공부하다
events.title_en: He studied chemical engineering at Tsinghua
events.description_en: He entered Tsinghua University's Department of Chemical Engineering and majored in organic synthesis.

events.title: 푸젠성 샤먼시 부시장이 되다
events.title_en: He became deputy mayor of Xiamen, Fujian
events.description: 푸젠성 샤먼시 부시장으로 부임하며 지방 행정 경력을 본격적으로 시작했다.
events.description_en: He took up the post of deputy mayor of Xiamen in Fujian Province, the start of a long run in provincial administration.

events.title: 푸저우시 당서기를 맡다
events.title_en: He became party secretary of Fuzhou
events.description: 푸젠성 푸저우시 당서기로 자리를 옮겨 이후 십수 년을 푸젠성에서 지방관으로 지냈다.
events.description_en: He moved to Fuzhou, Fujian, as party secretary and spent much of the next decade and more as a provincial official there.

events.title: 저장성으로 옮겨 성장 대행을 맡다
events.title_en: He moved to Zhejiang as acting governor
events.description: 저장성으로 옮겨 성장 대행을 맡았고, 이듬해 저장성 당서기에 올랐다.
events.description_en: He transferred to Zhejiang Province as acting governor and became the province's party secretary the following year.

events.title: 상하이 당서기를 거쳐 정치국 상무위원에 오르다
events.title_en: He led Shanghai then rose to the Politburo Standing Committee
events.description: 부패 스캔들로 물러난 전임자의 자리인 상하이시 당서기를 맡았다. 같은 해 안으로 중앙정치국 상무위원회에 들어가며 베이징 중앙 정치 무대로 옮겼다.
events.description_en: He took over as Shanghai party secretary after his predecessor was ousted in a corruption scandal. Within the same year he entered the Politburo Standing Committee, moving into national politics in Beijing.

events.title: 국가부주석이 되다
events.title_en: He became vice president of China
events.description: 중화인민공화국 국가부주석에 올라 차기 지도자로서 입지를 굳혔다.
events.description_en: He became vice president of the People's Republic of China, cementing his standing as the country's next leader.

events.title: 중국공산당 총서기에 선출되다
events.title_en: He was elected General Secretary of the Communist Party
events.description: 제18기 당대회를 거쳐 중국공산당 총서기와 중앙군사위원회 주석에 올랐다. 취임 직후 대대적인 반부패 운동을 시작했다.
events.description_en: Following the 18th Party Congress he became General Secretary of the Communist Party and chairman of the Central Military Commission. Soon after taking office he launched a sweeping anti-corruption campaign.

events.title: 국가주석에 취임하다
events.title_en: He was inaugurated as President of China
events.description: 전국인민대표대회에서 중화인민공화국 국가주석으로 선출되며 권력 이양을 마무리했다.
events.description_en: He was elected president of the People's Republic of China by the National People's Congress, completing the transfer of power.

events.title: 일대일로 구상을 내놓다
events.title_en: He unveiled the Belt and Road Initiative
events.description: 중앙아시아와 동남아시아 순방에서 육상·해상 실크로드를 잇는 일대일로 구상을 제시했다. 이후 중국 대외정책의 핵심 사업이 됐다.
events.description_en: During visits to Central and Southeast Asia he proposed the Belt and Road Initiative, linking overland and maritime silk roads. It became a central pillar of China's foreign policy.

events.title: 국가주석 임기 제한이 철폐되다
events.description: 전국인민대표대회가 헌법을 고쳐 국가주석의 임기 제한 조항을 없앴다. 그가 임기를 넘어 계속 집권할 길이 열렸다.
events.description_en: The National People's Congress amended the constitution to remove the two-term limit on the presidency, opening the way for him to remain in power beyond the previous limit.

events.title: 3연임에 오르다
events.description: 제20차 당대회에서 총서기로 다시 선출되며 세 번째 임기를 맡았다. 마오쩌둥 이후 처음으로 3연임한 지도자가 됐다.
events.description_en: At the 20th Party Congress he was re-elected General Secretary for a third term, becoming the first leader since Mao Zedong to hold the post for three consecutive terms.
